architectureDecisions: D1 — Edit only packages/oracle/src/retrieval-planner.js reserve(). execute() budget checks stay on reservedBudget (raw.length>reservedBudget.items and bytes>reservedBudget.materializedBytes). Do not change execute() catch mapping. GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1 runWork and its Math.min(8192, free.materializedBytes) items:1 expansion stay in planning-strategies.js (read-only).

D2 — Drop Math.min(8192, remainingBytes) with no replacement constant. reserve() takes explicit {items, bytes}, guards with reserved.providerCalls>=remaining.maxProviderCalls || reserved.items+items>remaining.maxItems || bytes<1, then reserved.providerCalls+=1; reserved.items+=items; reserved.materializedBytes+=bytes and records reservedBudget:{providerCalls:1,items,materializedBytes:bytes}. Magnitudes: R_BYTES=remaining.maxMaterializedBytes-reserved.materializedBytes; R_CALLS=remaining.maxProviderCalls-reserved.providerCalls (includes the current slot and any unused GRAPH expansion slot); R_ITEMS=remaining.maxItems-reserved.items; R_EXACT=count of itemRefs from this evidence's current itemRef index through later evidences that have itemRefs (later REPOSITORY/GRAPH/EXTERNAL without itemRefs are not in R_EXACT). READ_EXACT: items=1, bytes=Math.max(1, Math.floor(R_BYTES/Math.max(1,R_EXACT))) so a single remaining itemRef receives all remaining bytes. LOOKUP_SYMBOL, SEARCH_LEXICAL and STRUCTURAL_MAP: items=1, bytes=Math.max(1, Math.floor(R_BYTES/Math.max(1,R_CALLS))) so both REPOSITORY operations still reserve and one call-share of bytes remains for GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1 when the budget has headroom. TRAVERSE_GRAPH/FETCH_EXTERNAL: items=Math.max(1,R_ITEMS), bytes=R_BYTES. The superseded per-evidence-ops split (LOOKUP rem/2 + SEARCH rem: 10000+10000 of 20000, free 0) is revoked.

D3 — RP1 in retrieval-planner.test.js: 9000-byte EXACT file, budget maxMaterializedBytes 40000, snapshot authority present, execute+createOracleContextResolver COMPLETE with one candidate and reservedBudget.materializedBytes>8192 (covers execute() need 9358). This test fails on current main (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED). RP4 fails under the superseded D2 split (free bytes 0) and on current main (bytes 8192/8192, free 3616 — RP4 asserts the corrected 6666/6667 shares).

D4 — Keep execute() catch mapping: ProviderFailure.reason plus detail=error.message (ProviderFailure constructor sets message from detail). Do not add code. Probe mappingKeys are evidenceId,providerId,reason,detail.

After D2 TRAVERSE_GRAPH receives remaining maxItems (4) and remaining bytes (20000); assert itemRefs ['src/a.js','src/c.js'] and truncated false (found=2, maxItems=4). The CG3 64-byte tiny budget stays BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (one path materializes ~814 bytes). packages/agentic-system/test/oracle-context-adoption.test.js comments about min(8192) and BUDGET=3*8192: three one-itemRef evidences under remaining-refs sharing still each get 8192 of 24576, so the numeric budget stays sufficient; rewrite the comments to remaining-budget reservation rather than an 8192 per-item cap.
